# Spectra Interior Designing

> Luxury interior design studio based in Dubai, UAE. Residential, commercial, kitchen, bedroom, office design, 3D visualization, and an AI room designer tool.

Spectra Interior Designing creates bespoke, timeless interiors across Dubai. Services include Residential Interior Design, Commercial Interior Design, Kitchen Design, Bedroom Design, Office Design, and 3D Visualization. The site also offers a free AI-powered room redesign tool and an online consultation booking flow with an AED 500 refundable deposit.
